import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Routes, RoutesService } from 'src/app/services/routes.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-routes', templateUrl: './routes.component.html', styleUrls: ['./routes.component.css'] }) export class RoutesComponent implements OnInit { routes: Routes[] = []; // Per il form di creazione newRoute: Partial = { departure: '', destination: '', layoverFuel: [] }; // Controllo di editing inline editing: { [key: string]: boolean } = {}; editBuffer: { [key: string]: Partial } = {}; constructor(private svc: RoutesService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.loadAll(); } loadAll(): void { this.svc.getRoutes().subscribe({ next: data => this.routes = data, error: err => console.error('Caricamento failed', err) }); } // CREATE add(): void { if (!this.newRoute.departure || !this.newRoute.destination) return; this.svc.addRoute(this.newRoute as Routes).subscribe({ next: created => { this.routes.push(created); this.newRoute = { departure: '', destination: '', layoverFuel: [] }; this.loadAll(); }, error: err => console.error('Add failed', err) }); } // DELETE remove(id: string): void { this.svc.deleteRoute(id).subscribe({ next: () => { this.routes = this.routes.filter(r => r._id !== id); this.loadAll(); }, error: err => console.error('Delete failed', err) }); } // EDIT startEdit(r: Routes): void { this.editing[r._id] = true; // copia shallow per non toccare l’array originale this.editBuffer[r._id] = { departure: r.departure, destination: r.destination, layoverFuel: [...r.layoverFuel] }; } saveEdit(id: string): void { const data = this.editBuffer[id] as Routes; this.svc.editRoute(id, data).subscribe({ next: updated => { const idx = this.routes.findIndex(r => r._id === id); if (idx > -1) this.routes[idx] = updated; this.cancelEdit(id); this.loadAll(); }, error: err => console.error('Edit failed', err) }); } cancelEdit(id: string): void { delete this.editing[id]; delete this.editBuffer[id]; } // Utility per gestire layover come stringa CSV toCSV(arr: string[]): string { return arr.join(', '); } }
